method: Each 1536x1024 board cropped into three equal 512x1024 regions. No stretching, resampling, synthetic view rotation or per-view repositioning.
visual_limitations: Front and back weapon head have a small shoulder change compared with the assembly reference.
Ribbon side depth and back folds are inferred design completions from one front reference.
Ribbon view root/terminal vertical bounds differ by approximately 4/9 pixels, and local folds are not exact projections.
